requirements.title: Core AI Generation & Editing
requirements.description: Text-to-image (seed + N variations + size presets), image-to-image, inpaint (mask/box/text), and object removal run via >=1 standalone non-ComfyUI backend per op; ComfyUI optional plug-in.

validation.notes: Generation/edit op invokes selected standalone backend and persists params with output
Each AI gen/edit op completes headless via the async job system
